verdict.rationale: SES has a public pricing page describing pay-as-you-go pricing based on volume, with no contract negotiations or upfront commitments, so it can be priced without a sales call. The FAQ also publishes a free tier of 3,000 messages per month for 12 months. Dedicated IPs are confirmed as an extra charge, but the evidence never states the actual rates. Missing for 10: concrete per-message/per-volume rates or tiers, overage pricing, the dedicated IP lease price, validation add-on pricing, and independent corroboration that pricing is fully self-serve.
